completeness: Parametric voice: sound is generated by Wauvio-Vocal v2 from the formant, source and style values in voice.voice. There are NO recorded samples in this voicebank and none are needed. Japanese kana, yo-on, foreign-sound kana, ん, っ and ー are produced by the engine's rule-based phoneme model; see docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md for the kana the phoneme notation cannot express.
